Container.Name: lemon-manuals
Container.Overview: Serves the LEMON and CHARM car service manuals from a local copy of the LEMON torrent. Point the two paths at the torrent's lemon and charm folders (each must contain index.json); the container mounts them read-only, so you can keep seeding from the same files.

Config.Name: Lemon data
Config.Description: Host path to the torrent's lemon folder (must contain index.json)

Config.Name: Charm data
Config.Description: Host path to the torrent's charm folder (must contain index.json)
